title: Major questions
question: When does an agency need clear congressional authorization?

steps.note: A narrow reading avoids an unbounded delegation.
Questions of deep significance are not left to the agency.
The CDC eviction moratorium needs clear authorization.
The OSHA vaccine-or-test rule falls for want of clear authority.
The doctrine is named: extraordinary cases need clear congressional authorization.
Student-loan cancellation fails; Barrett explains the doctrine as contextual reading.
